steps.en: Add the shared lint and build presets as dev dependencies
steps.zh: 把共享的 lint 与构建预设装成开发依赖

steps.en: Spread the shared rules into eslint.config.js, then your own overrides
steps.zh: 在 eslint.config.js 里展开共享规则，再追加自己的覆盖

steps.en: Lints with type-aware TypeScript, import, Node and stylistic rules; skips dist, .nx, coverage
steps.zh: 用带类型信息的 TS、import、Node 与风格规则检查，跳过产物目录

steps.en: Merge its build preset last in vite.config.ts, naming the entry and source dir
steps.zh: 在 vite.config.ts 里最后合并它的构建预设，写明入口与源码目录

steps.en: Emits ESM + CJS files and .d.ts/.d.cts types with fixed import extensions; fails on type errors
steps.zh: 产出 ESM 与 CJS 文件及类型声明，补全导入扩展名，类型报错即中止

value.en: A package that lints and dual-publishes the way TanStack's own libraries do — without hand-writing the ESLint rule set or the dual-format Vite build
value.zh: 检查规则和 ESM/CJS 双格式产物与 TanStack 自家库一致，无需手写这两套配置

sources: docs/eslint.md (pnpm add -D @tanstack/eslint-config; eslint.config.js with ...tanstackConfig; plugin list)
docs/vite.md (pnpm add -D @tanstack/vite-config; mergeConfig + tanstackViteConfig({ entry: './src/index.ts', srcDir: './src' }); 'Legacy Setup' heading; tsdown adoption note)
packages/eslint-config/src/index.ts (GLOB_EXCLUDE incl. dist/.nx/coverage; parserOptions.project: true; stylistic/import-x/n plugins)
packages/vite-config/src/index.ts (formats es+cjs, preserveModules, vite-plugin-dts twice with .d.cts rename, ensureImportFileExtension, process.exit(1) on diagnostics)
